title: Personal touch
text: Tour guide was amazing.  Personalized the tour and gave us fascinating details. Made us see how wonderful personal tours can be!
author: Harold_K

title: Very interesting to walk...
text: Very interesting to walk along streets learning the history. Our tour guide was very funny and accommodating. He even had us playing guessing games for small prizes.
author: Sue_S

title: Excellent experience
text: Stephen was our tour guide. He gave us a very informative tour about the history of Spain from indigenous people to current situation. He explained great details on each site. 4/23 was St. George’s day. He also introduced this important date and events along the way. We enjoyed the whole trip very much and highly recommend the walking tour, especially with Stephen’s company! Thanks again! Cynthia
author: Oreoisthebest

title: El Barrio Barcelona
text:
The Gothic Quarter in Barcelona is beautiful, very different from the rest of the city, very fascinating full of history.
The Cathedral is magnificent
author: Betulla19

title: A very nice experience
text: A very interesting activity that allows us to visit areas of Barcelona that we did not know in detail. A big thank you to the guide Teresa, very pleasant and dynamic. The private tour makes this experience even more beautiful. To do again.
author: AntonyN186

title: Magnificent and suggestive Teaching Tour of Barcelona’s Gothic-Medieval Quarter
text: Detailed and enjoyable tour, in private, with which to discover the historic center of Barcelona full of charm. Robert, a magnificent guide, shows and documents perfectly each of the places that make up the itinerary, also explaining an endless number of events that took place in the area (such as the printing press that appears named in Don Quixote). Highly recommended!
author: jorge t

title: Visit of the cathedral
text:

author: Lylou1303

title: Stroll through the old world...
text: Walk down the old streets, visit the cathedral, and sip a drink at the harbour end. A nice old world part of Barcelona, with cathedral to visit at a cost of a few euros. Buy some post cards and stop to see the geece. Plenty restaurants and bars to rejuvenate your batteries.
author: Dianne W

title: True taste of the past
text: Very beautiful, both the cathedral and the context in which it is inserted. We stayed several days, in Barcelona, but we went , almost every day to see her. Don't miss it
